workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(editor): Initialize chat WebSocket when reposting a message. Target files: packages/frontend/@n8n/chat/src/types/chat.ts, packages/frontend/@n8n/chat/src/__tests__/Input.spec.ts, packages/frontend/@n8n/chat/src/__tests__/MessageActions.spec.ts. With the Chat Trigger in **Using Response Nodes** mode, Reposting a user message started a new execution but did not connect the chat WebSocket. The Chat node reply never reached the client, so the chat stayed in the waiting state and looked frozen. (Ref: https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/pull/43593)

workarounds.symptom: OIDC: a failed discovery is cached for one hour, so every login keeps failing until the cache expires or n8n restarts
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(core): Clear cached OIDC configuration when discovery fails. Target files: packages/cli/src/modules/sso-oidc/oidc.service.ee.ts, packages/cli/src/modules/sso-oidc/__tests__/oidc.service.ee.test.ts. This change ensures that `OidcService` resets its cached configuration when identity provider (IdP) discovery fails, allowing subsequent login requests to retry discovery. (Ref: https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/pull/43075)

workarounds.symptom: Native Agent workflow tools wait ~60s on workers: missing child job completion/failure listeners
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(core): Settle child job waits on workers from completion events. Target files: packages/cli/src/scaling/job-outcome-tracker.ts, packages/cli/src/scaling/scaling.service.ts, packages/cli/src/scaling/__tests__/scaling.service.test.ts. In queue mode, a worker can enqueue a job and wait for it. For example, a workflow tool of an Agent starts its sub-workflow through `WorkflowRunner`, and the sub-workflow runs on another worker. The worker listener handled only `abort-job`. It did not pass `job-finished` and `job-failed` messages... (Ref: https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/pull/43142)
